The compilerOptions.paths block below is NOT used by the app build (tsconfig.app.json owns that) — it exists so Netlify's esbuild function bundler can resolve the '@/*' alias that src/server/** uses transitively when bundling netlify/functions/*. Verified against a real deploy: without it every function fails at runtime with ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND '@/ai'.
